## Checklist

- [ ] I forked this repository and cloned **my fork** using SSH
- [ ] My branch is named `feature/add-{github-username}`
- [ ] I created `students/{github-username}/` with my website files
- [ ] I added **one** contributor card to `index.html`
- [ ] I did **not** edit other students' folders or sample folders
- [ ] I did not change shared layout, CSS, or JS except to add my card
- [ ] My commits use conventional, meaningful messages
- [ ] I opened this Pull Request against `SimulationEG/github-contributors` (`main`)
